theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (V W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep V n), IsOpen W → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure (K ∩ W) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ ∩ W) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Set.indicator (R.carrier ∩ W) (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x))) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)) → ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (z : Euclid (n + k)) (r : ℝ) (RT : IMRep U n) (𝓜 : Set (Measure (Euclid (n + k)))), 0 < r → closedBall z (2 * r) ⊆ U → RT.Represents T → (∀ μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k)), μ ∈ 𝓜 ↔ (∃ (a : Euclid (n + k)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t ∧ t ≤ r ∧ dist a z ≤ r - t ∧ μ = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • (RT.measure.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation a t)) ∨ ∃ (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (RS : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (b : Euclid (n + k)), (∀ i, dist (cs i) z < r - ts i) ∧ Tendsto ts atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto cs atTop (𝓝 b) ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i) (ts i) (hts i).ne') S ∧ RS.Represents S ∧ μ = RS.measure) → ∀ dens : Measure (Euclid (n + k)) → Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, (∀ (μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k))) (x : Euclid (n + k)), dens μ x = (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal) → (∀ μ ∈ 𝓜, ∀ K : Set (Euclid (n + k)), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) ∧ (∀ μ ∈ 𝓜, μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid (n + k))).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (dens μ x)))
